text.tspan: Violent crime rates in the United States1979 to 2024
Estimated rates per 100,000 people. Violent crime includes four offenses: murder and non-negligent
manslaughter, rape, robbery, and aggravated assault. Data for rape is not shown due to the lack of comparable
Robbery (taking something through force or violence)
Note: The FBI takes reported crime data and adjusts it for gaps and underreporting to provide consistent long-term estimates over time. That
means it may be different to reported crime figures.
